content: Funnel time-in-stage and conversion/dropout metrics are standard Postgres window-function territory: LAG()/LEAD() over ordered per-client stage-change rows to pair consecutive timestamps, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ...)/86400 for days-in-stage, COUNT(DISTINCT cliente) per stage for conversion %, and dropout = clients whose last recorded stage is a given stage with status_acompanhamento = perdido. No new library needed — native SQL in a Postgres view/RPC, same pattern as the existing dashboard aggregate views.
